name: Storylane
summary: Interactive product demos you can embed, with analytics on who watched what.
best_for: sales and marketing teams who show a product before a call and want to know which prospects clicked what — the free tier is genuinely usable for one demo
skip_if: you need more than one live demo but nowhere near 2,500 identified visitors a month, because that is exactly the gap the price ladder does not serve; a screen recording and a calendar link may do the job for less
honest_knock: The jump from Starter to Growth is $50 to $625 a month — twelve and a half times — and the free tier is capped at one live demo, so the moment you want a second demo published you are on the ladder. What is actually being sold at each step is visitor de-anonymisation: 250 a month on Starter, 2,500 on Growth, 10,000 on Premium. Price that against what you already pay a separate tool to do, because it is the meter that decides your tier, not the number of demos. Extra seats are charged on top at $40 to $100 each, which means a five-person sales team on Starter is not $50 a month, it is $210.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per month ($40 yearly), then nothing until Growth at $625/mo
pricing.notes: (2026-08-01, read on their own pricing page; the Demo Suite amounts were unchanged on 2026-09-29) Free $0: 1 seat, 1 published demo live at a time, unlimited views. Starter $50/month ($40 annual), 1 seat, extra seats $40 each, unlimited demos, de-anonymises 250 visitors/month. Growth $625/month ($500 annual), 5 seats, extra seats $100 each, 2,500 visitors/month. Premium $1,500/month ($1,200 annual), 10 seats, 10,000 visitors/month. Enterprise quote-only. Their RepX AI sales-agent product is priced separately and was restructured by 2026-09-29: Growth from $2,000/month for up to 20,000 monthly visitors, Premium from $3,000 for up to 60,000 with visitor de-anonymisation, Enterprise custom above that, each including Demo Suite interactive demos and a 30-day free trial.
